crossRefs.note: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by…

people.name: Abishai
people.line: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: Ammah
people.line: A hill near Gibeon, where Joab pursued Abner.

people.name: Giah
people.line: Location near Gibeon where Joab and Abishai pursued Abner.

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
translations.bsb: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. By sunset, they had gone as far as the hill of Ammah opposite Giah on the way to the wilderness of Gibeon.
translations.kjv: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
translations.asv: But Joab and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
